newsitem.title: GERMANY: Victoria 96 gp net profits to rise 25 pct.
newsitem.headline: Victoria 96 gp net profits to rise 25 pct.

text.p: German insurer Victoria Holding AG said on Wednesday it expected 1996 group net profits to rise 25 percent to over 100 million marks ($66.5 million) and said the earnings increase would allow for a dividend improvement.
Victoria said premium income would rise to 9.5 billion marks, up 250 million marks, including reserve for guarantees, despite what it called a difficult business environment.

The group said that the unit with the biggest growth rate was its Victoria Life Insurance AG unit. The actuarial results improved while investments were above last year's level, despite low interest rates.
